_comment: The external-source licence register. Every external repository or
publisher this product reads from has a record here before its material
is used for anything beyond reading it.
tests/test_external_sources.py is the gate. It fails when a record is
incomplete, when an intended use outruns the permissions recorded for it,
and when a source referenced in the repository has no record at all.
NO LICENCE FOUND IS NOT PERMISSION. An unresolved licence blocks reuse,
never discovery: facts and public API behaviour stay investigable, and
the executor may well conclude that nothing needed copying.
Every field below was read from the source on the date in `verified`.
Nothing here is inferred from a repository's reputation or its owner.

intended_use_levels.factual-discovery: Read to learn what exists. Nothing leaves the source.
intended_use_levels.reference-only: Cited or quoted briefly, with attribution. No code taken.
intended_use_levels.runtime-dependency: Invoked as an installed tool. Not vendored, not shipped.
intended_use_levels.adapted-implementation: An approach reimplemented here, not transcribed.
intended_use_levels.copied-code: Source text carried into this repository.
intended_use_levels.upstream-contribution: Work sent back to the source project.

sources.attribution: MIT notice and copyright must travel with any copied or modified source.
sources.content_license_note: One LICENSE covers the repository; no separate documentation licence exists.
sources.use_note: The collector calls PnP.PowerShell 3.3.0, which the operator installs. No source is vendored, copied or redistributed here.

sources.attribution: MIT notice and copyright must travel with any copied or modified source.
sources.content_license_note: The samples are markdown documents holding scripts, and the one LICENSE covers both.
sources.use_note: docs/PNP-INVENTORY.md counts samples by governance area and names three by filename. No sample text was read into this repository, and none may be without raising the intended use first.
sources.contribution_terms_note: No CONTRIBUTING file at the repository root or under .github/ on 2026-08-08. Unresolved, which is why upstream-contribution is not an intended use: the gate blocks it until somebody finds the terms.

sources.attribution: Short quotations are attributed in place and linked to the page quoted.
sources.content_license_note: Documentation prose is proprietary. Code samples on Learn are commonly published under MIT in their own repositories, which is a separate question to resolve per sample rather than assumed from the page.
sources.use_note: The normative authority for documented requirements, limits and guidance. Rules cite it; the repository quotes short passages with attribution and copies no page.
